desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Jujutsu Kaisen Escape⚡! 😈
Play as powerful sorcerers (or curses..) and test your reflexes in a high-speed escape challenge! 🌀

🧠 How to Play:
- Every run boosts your SPEED! ⚡
- Dodge deadly obstacles and survive the chaos to win! 🏃‍♂️💨
- Unlock unique characters with special boosts! 🔥
- Rebirth to unlock new perks! 🧬
- Train on the treadmill or run around the map to get faster! 💪

⚙️ Features:
- Smooth and responsive movement system 🌀
- Progressive speed scaling for intense gameplay ⚡
- Unlockable characters & powerful upgrades 🔥
- NO level cap! Grind to your heart's content! 😎

If you're built different and love speed… SMASH THAT LIKE ❤️❤️❤️
